# Car

Shows a **car's battery level** from a `sensor.*` entity as rings, with optional range, charging power and vehicle controls.

<figure><a href="../img/gallery/car_glow.png"><img src="../img/gallery/car_glow.png" alt="Car, Glow style" loading="lazy" width="240" height="340" style="width: 192px"></a></figure>
</div>

## Entities

| Entity | Domains |
| --- | --- |
| Battery level | `sensor.*` |
| Charging power *(optional)* | `sensor.*` |
| Range *(optional)* | `sensor.*` |
| Preconditioning *(optional)* | `switch.*`, `climate.*`, `button.*`, `select.*` |
| Door lock *(optional)* | `lock.*`, `binary_sensor.*` |
| Interior · °C *(optional)* | `sensor.*` |

## Requirements

None beyond the entities.

## Options

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Optional entities | only configured roles are shown; choose a free function with Add assignment, then select its entity; × removes a binding |

## On the panel

- Rings for the battery level and, when set, the range and charging power.
- From 200 × 330 px the lock state and interior temperature share a line under the rings, with the preconditioning button across the card below it; the Inspector says when the tile is too small for them.
- Preconditioning is a button; everything else is read-only. For a `climate.*`, `switch.*` or `input_boolean.*` the button reads **Sending...** after the call until the entity changes between on and off (at most 60 seconds); taps in between are ignored.

## Size

- Minimum: **200 × 200 px**.
- Maximum: **480 px × 560 px**, capped by the display's dashboard area.

The minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size. [Choose your display](../choose-display.md) lists the dashboard geometry; [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains spacing and touch targets.
